english.title: Conspire to fraudulently evade any duty / prohibition / restriction / provision
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) conspired together with

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_
(C)_[another person]_
(D)_[other persons]_

to fraudulently evade

(E)_[any duty chargeable on goods]_
(F)_[any prohibition or restriction for the time being in force with respect to goods under or by virtue of any enactment]_
(G)_[any provision of the Customs and Excise Acts 1979 applicable to goods]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE GOODS..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Law Act 1977.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
conspire to fraudulently evade any duty chargeable OR
a prohibition/restriction for the time being in force OR
a provision of the Customs and Excise Acts

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) There are DIFFERENT PENALTIES for possession of specific goods for export/import for which a prohibition/restriction was, for the time being in force and those apply to:-
(a) Section 3 of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971 (offence wordings H3656, H3657, H3658, H3659, H3660, H3661, H3662 and H3663),
(b) Sections 20 and 21 of the Forgery and Counterfeiting Act 1981 (offence wording H3665) and (c) Regulation 2 of the Seal Skins Regulations 1996 (offence wording H3667).
(ii) See section 171 for general provisions as to offences and penalties.
(iii) See section 49 for forfeiture provisions.
(iv) Section 61 was amended by Schedule 7 to the Taxation (Cross Border Trade) Act 2020, brought into force on the 31st December 2020 by SI 2020/1642. For any offences committed on or after the 31st December 2020, see offence wording document H100309 (CJS code CE79390C).
